XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Sudden engine shutdown and sporadic jerking, warning lights come on.
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: INJECTION | C1221 | WIRING | CONTROL UNIT | INJECTION | P0300 | P0302 | P0303 | P0641 | TURNS ON | TURNS OFF | START | JERKS | JERK | MIL | ABS | ENGINE | COLD |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: - -

  • Fault: Occasionally, the car suddenly stalls or runs roughly, with the engine fault and ABS fault warning lights coming on

  • Fault codes detected by the on-board diagnostics: One or more of the following:
    • P0641 (Sensor 1 reference voltage, open circuit)
    • P0300 (Misfires)
    • P0302 (Misfires in cylinder 2)
    • P0303 (Misfires in cylinder 3)
    • C1221 (Communication fault between ABS control unit and fuel injection system)
  • Cause: Faulty wiring in the engine compartment fuse box

• Action: Check the condition of the wiring in the engine compartment fuse box, clean the contacts with spray and restore the connections

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The engine compartment fuse box is located in the driver's side engine compartment, near the battery. In this case, there was obvious oxidation on the fuse box contacts. After cleaning the fuse box contacts with spray and restoring the connections, the fault was resolved.
